en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a central town square with a prominent historic town hall building topped by an ornate tower. In front of the town hall is a small monument or fountain, a horse‑drawn carriage, and a few pedestrians including a child in period clothing. Surrounding the square are multi‑story houses with steep roofs and dormer windows. The title "Waldenburg i. Sa. Rathaus." is printed at the top in red, and there are publisher details and signage such as "Rathskeller" visible on the town hall façade.
